description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום זו מתייחסת לאופן חלוקת תשלומים במקרה של נזקים או עלויות ניקיון המכוסים על ידי מספר פוליסות ביטוח. החברה לא תישא בחלק גדול יותר מהנזק מאשר הסכום המפורט בסעיף 3 בהצהרות, או הסכום המתקבל מחישוב חלוקה שווה בין המבטחים. לדוגמה, אם סעיף 3 מציין סכום של 100,000₪, זהו המקסימום שהפוליסה תכסה.
description.row_axis: Contribution methods and conditions for multiple insurance policies
notable_values: limits: Another contribution method based on policy limits

sketch:
When  both  this  insurance  and  other  insurance  apply  to  the  'cleanup  costs', 'loss', or "other loss" on the same basis, whether primary, excess or contingent, we shall not be liable under this policy for a greater proportion of the 'cleanup costs", or "other loss" than the amount set forth in Item 3 of the Declarations or the  amount  resulting  from  the  following  contribution  methods,  whichever  is lesser:
Contribution by equal shares - Under this approach each insurer contributes equal amounts until it has paid its applicable limit of insurance or none of the 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" remains, whichever occurs first; or
Contribution  by  limits  -  each  insurer's  share  is  based  on  the  ratio  of  its applicable limit of insurance to the total applicable limits of insurance of all insurers.

This table details how insurance contributions are calculated when multiple policies cover the same 'cleanup costs' or 'loss'. It outlines methods like equal shares and contribution by limits, referencing 'Item 3 of the Declarations'.
ממדים: Contribution methods and conditions for multiple insurance policies, Details of contribution calculation

When  both  this  insurance  and  other  insurance  apply  to  the  'cleanup  costs', 'loss', or "other loss" on the same basis, whether primary, excess or contingent, we shall not be liable under this policy for a greater proportion of the 'cleanup costs", or "other loss" than the amount set forth in Item 3 of the Declarations or the  amount  resulting  from  the  following  contribution  methods,  whichever  is lesser:
Contribution by equal shares - Under this approach each insurer contributes equal amounts until it has paid its applicable limit of insurance or none of the 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss" remains, whichever occurs first; or
Contribution  by  limits  -  each  insurer's  share  is  based  on  the  ratio  of  its applicable limit of insurance to the total applicable limits of insurance of all insurers.
